rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: CHAP. LV. Of Partnership.
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: Chapter LV begins after the printed horizontal divider on PDF411.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: new source chapter only

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: The Lord of the ascendant is for the querent
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: For this partnership question, the ascendant lord signifies the querent.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: first-house lord assigned to querent

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: Lord of the seventh for the Partner intended
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: The seventh-house lord represents the intended partner, subject to the described in-house-planet qualification.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: seventh lord is default, NOT invariably fixed

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: observe what Planet is in the seventh, and neer the cusp
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: If another planet lies in or near the seventh cusp and better fits the description of the person asked about, that planet can be chosen as the partner significator.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: planet in/nearing seventh AND descriptor-match compared with seventh lord
rows.exception_or_ambiguity: Source selection by observed description creates substantial retrospective degrees of freedom.

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: Let the Moon be partner in signification
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: Moon is also included as an additional significator in the partnership reading.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: Moon additional source role
rows.exception_or_ambiguity: Do not assume Moon replaces first/seventh lord.

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: the tenth house shall shew what credit there may come
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: The tenth house is said to show credit or reputation accruing to the partnership.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: tenth house: reputation or credit

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: whether Partnership will extend to good or ill ... fourth ... Moon applies
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: To judge whether a partnership will end well, examine the fourth house, its lord, planets therein and the planet Moon applies to.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: fourth house AND fourth lord AND its planets AND Moon applying planet

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: Lord of the ascendant and Moon be in movable Signs; without Reception
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: First lord AND Moon in movable signs without reception by house, exaltation, triplicity or term is given as a contention/disagreement condition.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: both first lord and Moon movable AND absent reception in named dignity modes

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: matters will againe be reconciled ... Partnership will hold ... mistrustfull
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: After the movable/no-reception disagreement, the author says reconciliation and partnership continuation may occur but with mistrust and little benefit.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: depends on previous movable signs and missing reception; not a separate success case

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: Significators be in fixed Signes, their society will continue long
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: Partners significators in fixed signs are said to favor long duration of the association.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: both relevant significators in fixed signs

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: but if no Reception be, little profit will ... accrue
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: The prolonged fixed-sign partnership is said to yield little profit when the required reception is absent.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: fixed signs AND no reception

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: if they buy any thing, Commodities will lye long on their hands
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: Purchases are said to remain unsold for a long time under the preceding fixed/no-reception condition.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: depends on fixed signs and no reception (immediate paragraph antecedent)

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: Significators be in common Signes ... gainfull Partnership
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: In common (mutable) signs the text predicts a gainful partnership and mutual faithfulness.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: both relevant significators in common signs
rows.exception_or_ambiguity: Do not confuse with first-lord+Moon movable-sign rule.

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: one Significator ... movable ... other ... fixed ... disturbance ... lesse
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: One movable and one fixed significator are said to produce less disturbance than initially feared.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: one movable AND the other fixed

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: ill Planets aspect both the significators viz Lord ... ascendant ... seventh
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: Malefic aspects to BOTH first- and seventh-lord are said to make the partnership unfair to both.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: malefic planets aspect both first AND seventh lords

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: see where, and in what house or houses ... evill Planets ... cause
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: The author instructs readers to consider the malefics house locations when attributing causes, without a complete causal rule.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: diagnostic source advice, not empirical identification

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: evill Planet in the ascendant ... querent false companion
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: An ill planet in the first is claimed to indicate the querent is an untrustworthy companion.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: malefic planet in first house
rows.exception_or_ambiguity: Historical character attribution, no person-level confirmation.

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: judge the like if an evill Planet be in the seventh
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: Likewise a malefic in the seventh is alleged to indicate the partner is untrustworthy.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: malefic planet in seventh house

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: Moon separate from one Fortune and apply to another
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: Moon separating from one benefic and applying to another is said to make the partnership begin and end well but without wealth.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: Moon separates benefic A AND applies benefic B
rows.exception_or_ambiguity: Start/end and no wealth must remain together.

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: separated from a good Planet, and apply to an ill
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: Moon separating from a benefic and applying to a malefic is said to begin well but end in conflict and hatred.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: Moon separates benefic AND applies malefic

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: and so the contrary
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: The passage includes an abbreviated converse for previous lunar applications but does not print a full inverse condition-to-outcome table.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: converse shorthand only; inverse not algorithmically expanded

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: Moon separated from an ill Planet and apply to another
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: Moon separating from a malefic and applying to another planet (whose quality is not expressly re-specified here) is said to begin with complaints, continue in fear/jealousy and end in lawsuits.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: Moon separates malefic AND applies to another planet (quality unspecified)
rows.exception_or_ambiguity: Do not silently assume another malefic from absent adjective.

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: good Planet in the tenth ... reputation ... rejoice
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: A benefic in the tenth is claimed to bring reputation and mutual pleasure from the partnership.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: benefic in tenth

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: good Planet in second best for querent ... seventh for Partner
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: A benefic in second favors the querent; a benefic in seventh favors the partner; directional source assignments differ.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: second benefic -> querent; seventh benefic -> partner

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: ill Planet in the second, or node-like glyph ... querent get little
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: An ill planet in the second OR printed node-like glyph is said to imply little return for the querent, possible cheating and debts.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: second-house malefic OR source glyph; position/scope of glyph remains unresolved

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: Lord of the fourth apply ... eleventh by sextile or trine
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: Applying fourth lord to eleventh lord by sextile OR trine is offered as one favorable partnership-ending testimony.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: fourth lord applies eleventh lord AND aspect sextile OR trine

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: or if a good Planet be in the fourth
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: A benefic located in the fourth is listed as an ALTERNATIVE favorable ending condition.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: good planet fourth; OR with prior conditions

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: Lords of eleventh and fourth be in Reception
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: A reception relationship between eleventh lord and fourth lord is another alternative positive ending condition.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: reception between eleventh and fourth lords

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: good Planets cast sextile or trine to Lords of ascendant and seventh
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: Benefics casting sextile or trine aspects to the first and seventh lords are an additional favorable end-of-partnership condition.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: good planet aspects by sextile OR trine toward BOTH lords first and seventh

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: observe Part of Fortune glyph, how dignified, how aspected
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: The scanned symbol appears to be the Part of Fortune; Lilly asks readers to inspect its dignities/aspects before the following negative qualification.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: inspect printed circled-cross glyph condition; identity held provisional
rows.exception_or_ambiguity: Glyph visually resolved only to circled-cross appearance, not a universal referent.

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: Lord of the seventh or eighth cast square or opposition to it
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: The seventh OR eighth lord squaring or opposing that printed point is claimed to indicate little good from a partner and possible embezzlement of property/common stock.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: seventh OR eighth lord square OR opposition to circled-cross point
rows.exception_or_ambiguity: Historical forecast only; cross-page; precise symbolic referent remains flagged.

rows.anchor_editorially_shortened_not_diploma: CHAP. LVI. Whether a City, Towne or Castle ... shall be taken or not
rows.conditional_statement_author_claim_not_e: Chapter LV ends above the printed divider on PDF413; Chapter LVI siege heading begins below and its body is excluded.
rows.preconditions_and_disjunctions: boundary only; no Chapter LVI siege claims
